---
# Source: lapilli/templates/serviceaccount.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
# Source: lapilli/templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli-ledger
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
  annotations:
    # The ledger outlives the release unless deleted by hand.
    helm.sh/resource-policy: keep
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 2Gi
---
# Source: lapilli/templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
spec:
  # Inside the cluster: every port, as jobs, alert managers and Prometheus
  # reach them. The UI outside it is FULLNAME-ui's (serve.service.type).
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/component: serve
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: http
    # /metrics and the health checks, alone: what Prometheus needs.
    - name: metrics
      port: 9091
      targetPort: metrics
---
# Source: lapilli/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    # One pod: the old stops before the new one starts. A SQLite ledger is
    # its volume's; a Postgres one, upgraded from 0.35 or before,
    # is refused to a new pod while an old one holds it alone.
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
      app.kubernetes.io/component: serve
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: serve
        app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
        helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: ops-lapilli
      # Mounted in lapilli's container alone, when a cloud's identity may
      # need it (lapilli.saToken), not in the rules history's.
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 65532
        runAsGroup: 65532
        fsGroup: 65532
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: lapilli
          image: "ghcr.io/lapilli-project/lapilli:dev"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          args:
            - serve
            - --ledger=/var/lib/lapilli
            - --listen=:8080
            - "--metrics-listen=:9091"
            - "--every=1h"
            - "--settle=1h"
            - "--backfill=28d"
            - "--keep=400d"
            - "--digest=mon@09:00"
            - "--timeout=50m"
            - "--lang=en"
            - "--tz=Etc/UTC"
            - "--prometheus=http://prometheus:9090"
            - "--rules=/etc/lapilli/rules/0"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 9091
          env:
            - name: GOMEMLIMIT
              valueFrom:
                resourceFieldRef:
                  resource: limits.memory
                  # Said, not left to the API server's default ("0"): resourceFieldRef
                  # is atomic, so a GitOps diff of the applied fields sees the default
                  # as a change. "1" is the same value, in bytes.
                  divisor: "1"
          # Ready once the first run is done (serve.readinessPath), so a
          # load balancer sends people to a UI with something in it.
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /readyz, port: metrics}
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: metrics}
            periodSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 4
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 1Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: ledger
              mountPath: /var/lib/lapilli
            - name: rules-0
              mountPath: /etc/lapilli/rules/0
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: ledger
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: ops-lapilli-ledger
        - name: rules-0
          projected:
            sources:
              - configMap:
                  name: rules
